scope/reference.caveat: All assigned trials, including failures. Unequal audited success rates are not quality parity; paired-success results are reported separately.

scope/cline.caveat: All assigned trials, including failures. Unequal audited success rates are not quality parity; paired-success results are reported separately.

auditSensitivityCaveat: Primary F44 acceptance requires a new valid regression test and preserves existing tests/configuration. Source-only sensitivity excludes instruction compliance, not added-test correctness. No sensitivity replaces the registered primary metric.
optionalConfigShapeSensitivityCaveat: Legacy summary-schema fields are retained for compatibility; no F44 absent-option-shape or append-only exception is used. They do not constitute additional F44 sensitivity experiments.
functionalComparisonCaveat: Secondary descriptive comparison on selected-check success only. It can include incorrect extra changes or instruction violations; it cannot establish full-task quality parity.

accounting.method: Known SDK estimates plus explicit missing-aggregate/unreported-request reserves, not imputed consumption. Wire/report counts do not establish billing or hidden retries.

incompleteTrialAccounting: Missing final aggregates and durations remain null. Known partial per-request SDK cost receipts are reported separately, never substituted for a complete trial total; scheduling retains the full missing-aggregate allowance. Administrative interruptions stay in assigned denominators and are not model retries or demonstrated harness failures.
limitations: 3 constructed tasks in 2 project(s), 3 dependent repeats. Three new constructed requests on previously studied Valibot/Remeda, selected in the published engineering plan before any F44 model results; three dependent repeats. Tasks explicitly require a new regression-test file, so this is a validation-focused cohort, not representative issue prevalence or a new-project confirmation. Known F42/F43 diagnostics guide the mechanism, not model-task selection after outcomes. Unblinded source review by the research agent, unknown provider revision/seeds/invoices, nonexclusive host. SDK estimates/cache receipts are observations, not complete provider billing. Do not pool campaigns or attribute resource differences to unused mechanisms. Whole private workspace archives are retained by SHA-256; public traces include original diffs, events, grades, contracts and deliveries. Recorded host workload overlaps and duration sensitivities are reported separately; unknown contention is not excluded.
